test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under which Ministry does the Indian Antarctic Act, 2022 aim at having India's own national measures for protecting the Antarctic environment along with the dependent and associated ecosystems and proposes to set up Indian Antarctic Authority (IAA)?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Earth Sciences.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Indian Antarctic Act, 2022 **aims to protect the **Antarctic environment** and its dependent and associated ecosystems.
 
• The act proposes to set up the **Indian Antarctic Authority (IAA)** to implement national measures for** protecting the environment.**
 
• The **Ministry of Earth Sciences** is responsible for the implementation of the act.
 
• **Kiren Rijiju** is the Union Cabinet Minister in place right now.
 
• India has been a signatory to the **Antarctic Treaty since 1983 **and has been conducting scientific expeditions to the continent since then.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Power** is responsible for the development of **electrical power** in the country.

 
 
• **Raj Kumar Singh** is the Union Cabinet Minister in place right now.
 
 
 
• The **Ministry of Textiles** is responsible for the development of textiles and the welfare of workers in the textile industry.
 
 
• **Piyush Goyal** is the Union Cabinet Minister in place right now.
 
 
 
• The **Ministry of Science and Technology** is responsible for the development of scientific research and technology in the country.
 
 
• Its headquarters is in **New Delhi.**
